programme.title: Time to Schein
programme.desc: Time to Schein (Sports). Since talking sports during his undergrad days on the Syracuse University airwaves, Adam Schein's passionate, energetic, fan-friendly style has served him well, from the legendary WFAN in New York to a daily show on Sirius Radio. It's also prepared him for his dream job – «Time to Schein,» a national weekday series on CBS Sports Network. In a fast-moving, unscripted format, the host presents his unique perspective on the latest news and social media trends, provides bold predictions and interacts with key players, personalities and league personnel. Schein also hosts «That Other Pregame Show» and «NFL Monday QB» on CBS Sports Network during the NFL season

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Le Belge Lucas Coenen (KTM), le Néerlandais Jeffrey Herlings et le Français Tom Vialle (Honda) se disputent la tête du championnat du monde MXGP en ce début de saison. L'Avignonnais s'est notamment imposé lors du Grand Prix de Suisse, à Frauenfeld. Va-t-il récidiver devant son public, sur le circuit de Lacapelle-Marival ?

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Après la Chine, direction la Suisse et Berne, pour la deuxième épreuve de bloc de la saison de coupe du monde. A suivre, dans cette discipline, le triple tenant du titre, le Japonais Sorato Anraku. Parmi ses principaux adversaires, le Français Mejdi Schalck, 22 ans, médaillé d'argent au classement général de bloc, la saison dernière.

programme.title: Triathlon : Pampelune T100
programme.desc: Pampelune accueille un événement international destiné aux triathlètes professionnels et amateurs. Les participants devront parcourir 100 kilomètres au total, divisés en trois sections : 2 km de natation, 80 km de vélo et 18 km de course à pied. L'épreuve commence au barrage d'Alloz, se poursuit à vélo sur la route autour de la ville et se termine sur la Plaza del Castillo, au coeur de la vieille ville.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Cette 14e étape du Giro 2026 prend l'allure d'une grande étape alpine constituée d'une succession ininterrompue de montées et de descentes, presque sans répit.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de cross-country, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Nove Mesto, en République tchèque, accueille la deuxième manche de la Coupe du monde de VTT cross-country. L'Américain Christopher Blevins va-t-il confirmer sa domination de la saison dernière sur la discipline ? On suivra également les performances des Français Luca Martin, Mathis Azzaro et Adrien Boichis.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Une étape entièrement plate qui ne devrait pas échapper aux sprinteurs. Départ de Voghera jusqu'à Pavie, sur des routes larges et rectilignes. De Pavie à Milan, le peloton empruntera la route historique de Sanremo pour entrer, après la Chiesa Rossa, sur le circuit final de 16,3 km, à parcourir à quatre reprises.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Berne, en Suisse, accueille la 2e manche de la coupe du monde de bloc de la saison. Le grimpeuse française de 22 ans Zélia Avezou a remporté la première manche en Chine, à Keqiao. Elle a devancé la légende slovène Janja Garnbret et l'Australienne Oceana Mackenzie. Côté messieurs, le Français Mejdi Schalck a décroché le bronze, derrière le Japonais Sorato Anraku et le Sud-Coréen Lee Do-hyun.

programme.title: ⋗ MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Central (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's «The Rundown. programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: The Timeline: September 11th
programme.desc: The Timeline (Sports). The master storytellers at NFL Films collaborate with VIP celebrities like George Clooney, Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner to chronicle seminal moments in the league's illustrious history. Clooney co-produces the story about how a smuggled audio recording of Super Bowl XIV buoys the spirits of U.S. hostages in Iran in 1980. McGraw co-produces, narrates and contributes music to an episode detailing his close friend Brett Favre's return to Green Bay as a member of the rival Minnesota Vikings. And Renner lends his voice to a two-part film examining the rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, and the impact each franchise has had on its city. Episodes also detail the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the landmark move of the Giants from New York to New Jersey

programme.title: The Timeline: The Tuck Rule
programme.desc: The Timeline (Sports). The master storytellers at NFL Films collaborate with VIP celebrities like George Clooney, Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner to chronicle seminal moments in the league's illustrious history. Clooney co-produces the story about how a smuggled audio recording of Super Bowl XIV buoys the spirits of U.S. hostages in Iran in 1980. McGraw co-produces, narrates and contributes music to an episode detailing his close friend Brett Favre's return to Green Bay as a member of the rival Minnesota Vikings. And Renner lends his voice to a two-part film examining the rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, and the impact each franchise has had on its city. Episodes also detail the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the landmark move of the Giants from New York to New Jersey

programme.title: Triathlon : Pampelune T100
programme.desc: Pampelune accueille un événement international destiné aux triathlètes professionnels et amateurs. Les participants devront parcourir 100 kilomètres au total, divisés en trois sections : 2 km de natation, 80 km de vélo et 18 km de course à pied. L'épreuve commence au barrage d'Alloz, se poursuit à vélo sur la route autour de la ville et se termine sur la Plaza del Castillo, au coeur de la vieille ville.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Après la Chine, direction la Suisse et Berne, pour la deuxième épreuve de bloc de la saison de coupe du monde. A suivre, dans cette discipline, le triple tenant du titre, le Japonais Sorato Anraku. Parmi ses principaux adversaires, le Français Mejdi Schalck, 22 ans, médaillé d'argent au classement général de bloc, la saison dernière.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de cross-country, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Nove Mesto, en République tchèque, accueille la deuxième manche de la Coupe du monde de VTT cross-country. L'Américain Christopher Blevins va-t-il confirmer sa domination de la saison dernière sur la discipline ? On suivra également les performances des Français Luca Martin, Mathis Azzaro et Adrien Boichis.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Suivez le célèbre Tour d'Italie de cyclisme, appelé Il Giro. Organisé par l'UCI, le Tour se déroule en mai et juin sur 21 étapes pendant 23 ou 24 jours et consiste en au moins deux contre-la-montre et des étapes de montagne. Le Giro d'Italia est, avec le Tour d'Espagne et le Tour de France, l'un des trois grands tours de cyclisme sur route. Sa première édition a eu lieu en 1909.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Antwerp Port Epic
programme.desc: Suivez l'Antwerp Port Epic ou autrement appelé l'Antwerp Port Epic-Sels Trophy, l'épreuve cycliste qui fait partie de l'UCI Europe Tour en catégorie 1.1. Créé en 2018, cette course se déroule annuellement en septembre en Belgique.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Les 100 premiers kilomètres qui suivront le départ de Cervia sont plats. Puis, les coureurs verront la route se durcir, avec une ascension finale qui se fera en deux temps.

programme.desc: Cette 14e étape du Giro 2026 prend l'allure d'une grande étape alpine constituée d'une succession ininterrompue de montées et de descentes, presque sans répit.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Cette 14e étape du Giro 2026 prend l'allure d'une grande étape alpine constituée d'une succession ininterrompue de montées et de descentes, presque sans répit.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de cross-country, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de cross-country
programme.desc: Nove Mesto, en République tchèque, accueille la deuxième manche de la Coupe du monde de VTT cross-country. L'Américain Christopher Blevins va-t-il confirmer sa domination de la saison dernière sur la discipline ? On suivra également les performances des Français Luca Martin, Mathis Azzaro et Adrien Boichis.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour d'Italie
programme.desc: Une étape entièrement plate qui ne devrait pas échapper aux sprinteurs. Départ de Voghera jusqu'à Pavie, sur des routes larges et rectilignes. De Pavie à Milan, le peloton empruntera la route historique de Sanremo pour entrer, après la Chiesa Rossa, sur le circuit final de 16,3 km, à parcourir à quatre reprises.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Berne, en Suisse, accueille la 2e manche de la coupe du monde de bloc de la saison. Le grimpeuse française de 22 ans Zélia Avezou a remporté la première manche en Chine, à Keqiao. Elle a devancé la légende slovène Janja Garnbret et l'Australienne Oceana Mackenzie. Côté messieurs, le Français Mejdi Schalck a décroché le bronze, derrière le Japonais Sorato Anraku et le Sud-Coréen Lee Do-hyun.

programme.title: The Timeline: September 11th
programme.desc: The Timeline (Sports). The master storytellers at NFL Films collaborate with VIP celebrities like George Clooney, Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner to chronicle seminal moments in the league's illustrious history. Clooney co-produces the story about how a smuggled audio recording of Super Bowl XIV buoys the spirits of U.S. hostages in Iran in 1980. McGraw co-produces, narrates and contributes music to an episode detailing his close friend Brett Favre's return to Green Bay as a member of the rival Minnesota Vikings. And Renner lends his voice to a two-part film examining the rivalry between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, and the impact each franchise has had on its city. Episodes also detail the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the landmark move of the Giants from New York to New Jersey

The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ NHL Hockey: Colorado Avalanche at Vegas Golden Knights (T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, NV, USA)
programme.desc: NHL. Colorado Avalanche vs. Vegas Golden KnightsThe Colorado Avalanche and Vegas Golden Knights clash in Game 3 of the Western Conference Final. Guests: Colorado Avalanche at Vegas Golden Knights

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike & Mike» morning show

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers.
